I knock on Sana’s door and-
: Aaaah! Sana...wait! I wasn’t ready yet! You need to warn me before — ngh?!
: Just...a little more!
: It’s too...tight! I can’t...handle it!
...and I think I’m just going to stand out here for a little while and give those two some space.
: Almost...there!
: Hngh! I feel like...I’m about to...burst!
Wait, why on earth would I give them their space when I could just invade it instead?
scene black
: I’m coming in. Don’t finish without-
scene sanaayaneclothes1
: There. It’s finally on now. You should be able to breathe again.
: Phew...I hope I’m not gaining weight. Are corsets always like this? Because I’ve gained a newfound respect for you today if they are.
: This one’s too big for me. Mine actually fit, so it’s only a little hard to-
: Ahem.
scene sanaayaneclothes2
: Oh, Sensei...When did you walk in?
: As soon as all the fun stopped, unfortunately. And, despite this not being the sight I wanted to see, I am still thankful I get to see Ayane dressed in...whatever she is currently dressed in.
: Miss Watabe gave some of her old clothes to Sana and-
scene sanaayaneclothes3
: MNGH?!?!? SANA?!
: Sorry. Just making sure it’s on all the way.
: Maybe tug it once more for good measure.
scene sanaayaneclothes4
: If Sensei thinks that’s best...
: Don’t! I’ll literally die! I can already feel my insides being crushed as we speak!
: Mm...that sounds nice.
: Well, it’s not! Sensei, stop her!
: Call me what you’re supposed to be calling me now.
scene sanaayaneclothes5
: Akira, stop her! My control over Sana has long since vanished and you’re the only one who can silence this demon now!
: If I tighten it any more, it might snap. So let’s just say you’ve lucked out this time.
scene sanaayaneclothes6
: Wh...What are you doing here anyway? If I’d have known you were coming, I would have waited for another night to let Sana play dress-up with my body.
: Like Ayane was saying before I stimulated her, a lot of the clothes Miss Watabe gave me are a little too big. So we thought it’d be fun if she tried them on instead.
: Is...stimulated really the right word to be using there?
: Whatever the circumstances, I wouldn’t mind you dressing like this more often, Ayane. Same goes for that dress you wore at the last Dorm Wars.
scene sanaayaneclothes7
: Th...This feels a...lot more embarrassing than...that did for...some reason...
: Are girls who wear things like this really your type after all? Am I actually losing points by dressing less...conservatively now?
: I wouldn’t say you’re losing points. But there is a certain allure that comes from layer after layer of clothing. Like you need to work harder to see what’s beneath it all.
scene sanaayaneclothes8
: I’m surprised you like Ayane in these, then. I figured you’d have her body memorized by now.
: Oh, I most definitely do. But all of the ties and ribbons are like enrichment for me because I am an animal at my core.

: I feel very objectified right now. Which isn’t to say I dislike it. I just also want to curl up in a ball and burst into flames since I didn’t have the time to mentally prepare myself to be seen like-
scene sanaayaneclothes9
: Aaah! Sana! I...thought you said it was all the way in!
: Don’t you mean “on?”
: Th...That’s what I said!
: Let her go before you kill her, Sana.
: You’re just jealous that you aren’t the only person who can make her make noises like that anymore.
: That is very likely true on a subconscious level, so I will not outright deny it and just say “please” instead.
: I’ll think about it. Even I can’t help but fawn over her when she looks so out of character. It’s like I’m seeing something I’m not supposed to right now.
: Is that why you’re still holding me hostage? Let go of the corset! There’s only one person who’s allowed to put me on a leash and it’s Sensei!
: Akira.
: You both know what I mean! I-
scene sanaayaneclothes10
: Ahh...
: Free at last...
scene sanaayaneclothes11
: Ack!
: Yeah...that’s how I always feel at the end of the day too.
scene sanaayaneclothes12
: So how many of these have you worn? What percentage of the fashion show have I missed?
: This is the fourth, I think. Miss Watabe gave Sana a lot. Some of it seems really high quality, too.
: Well, she was a rich girl at one point, so that only makes sense.
: I’m technically a rich girl too and I still buy most of my clothes off SHEIN.
: Am I supposed to know what that is?
: Only if you want to buy me a birthday present this year. I’ll wear anything you pick out.
: I’m not really the best when it comes to fashion, as I’m sure you’ve noticed.
: They have lingerie too.
: I’ll see what I can do.
scene sanaayaneclothes13
: Sana, what are-
scene sanaayaneclothes14
: Oh my God! What do you think you’re doing?!
scene sanaayaneclothes15
: Huh? Getting undressed.
: Right in front of us?!
: Yeah...It’s no fair if only you get to dress out of character. I want to make Sensei’s heart pound too.
: I would like my heart to pound as well, but Ayane is currently obscuring my vision and should stop if she knows what’s good for her.
: Have sex with her all you want, but watching her get undressed is a different level of lewd that shouldn’t be normalized!
: Can I at least put on your clothes before I have sex with him?
: Wait, my clothes? Why do you want to put on my clothes?
: Because I don’t have anything brightly colored, obviously. You still have some of your clothes from middle school under the bed, don’t you?
: I do, but-
: Go, Sana. Strip. Do not listen to this girl, for she does not understand the gravity of what is happening right now.
scene sanaayaneclothes16

: Of course I understand the gravity of what’s happening right now! Nobody appreciates Sana’s cuteness more than me and she’s about to wear my clothes! Do you have any idea how excited I am?! I can barely contain it!
: Okay, maybe you do get it then.
: I do! And it’s because I get it that we shouldn’t be looking at her at all until she’s dressed up or it’ll just ruin the surprise!
: See, now you’ve lost me again.
scene sanaayaneclothes17
: Sana, how about we just leave the room and-
scene sanaayaneclothes18
: JESUS CHRIST!
: Is literally everything you’ve ever worn blue? You don’t have any other colors at all?
: Have you no decency?! You’re not even wearing panties!
: What do you mean? The only reason I’m covering myself up is because you keep freaking out about it. Is that not decency?
: You’re barely covered up at all! If the camera angle shifts even a little bit, it’ll reveal literally everything!
scene sanaayaneclothes19
: Oh. Well, I guess there’s no point in trying to hide anything then. Do you think that sundress you wore in elementary school would fit me?
scene sanaayaneclothes20
: Yes.
: As a matter of fact, I do...
: E...Elementary school?...
: I sure hope it’s not too big...
scene sanaayaneclothes21
: Too...big?...
: Eyes over here, future husband. You’re already on thin ice for...well...literally everything you have ever done.
scene sanaayaneclothes22
: I’m sorry and I love you.
: I love you too.
: Great. So, since we love each other, I think it only makes sense if we watch her get dressed together as it will help strengthen our bond.
: How will watching my naked roommate put on my old clothes strengthen our bond?
: Because we bond through sex and watching her will strengthen my penis.
: That actually somehow makes sense to me.
: I’m going to interpret that as permission to look then.
: Do you want to just make out instead? Because it’s been a while and I think it would help calm me down.
: But-
: Watch your words very closely right now, Akira. There are many wrong things to say and very few correct ones.
scene sanaayaneclothes23
: Excuse me, but...
scene sanaayaneclothes24
: I’d actually prefer it if you guys paid a little more attention to me instead of each other now, thanks.
scene sanaayaneclothes25
: Did...Did we die?
: Uhhhhh...
: We died, right? And this is Heaven. Because that is an angel. I know an angel when I see one.
: Am I cute? Did I make your hearts skip a beat?
: Marry me.
: I thought I was supposed to marry you?
: I changed my mind. I want Sana now.
scene sanaayaneclothes26
: I’m not really sure how much I like this. I feel very...exposed right now. Are these types of dresses always this...airy?
: You’re...You are wearing panties now, right?
scene sanaayaneclothes27
: Ohhhhhhh...I guess that would explain it.
: Hah...Okay, Sensei. You’re back at the top of the marriage list.
: I’m not wearing underwear either.
: You both disgust me. And you leave me no choice but to take off mine as well.
scene black
scene sanaayaneclothes28
Now, you’re probably wondering how I wound up in this situation.
And the reason you’re probably wondering that is because I know firsthand just how hard it’s been to focus with these two being as cute as they have been tonight.
But I can say with utmost certainty that my struggles are, in no way, close to ending since the only reason I haven’t thrown myself at them is because I know Ayane doesn’t like threesomes.
scene sanaayaneclothes29
: I know what you’re thinking and I’m sorry.
: I also know what you’re thinking and I’m not.
scene sanaayaneclothes30
: Life is pain. This much, I have already come to accept.
: You know...maybe you and I should try out some new styles, Sana? It’s pretty boring wearing the same thing all the time, right?
scene sanaayaneclothes31
: We should go shopping together. There are a bunch of new shops at the mall, and I’m sure most of them have youth sections.
: Youth sections...
: I’d say we should bring Sensei along as well, but I’m not sure he’d be able to contain himself.
: I agree. In fact, I imagine this is a pretty intense test of self-control right now. We seem to be appealing to him in ways I’m not sure he ever thought we would.
: This rivalry is really ramping up, isn’t it? I can’t help but wonder who will end up on top.
: Why, yes. In fact, it seems quite possible that there may even be some sort of come from behind victory.
: Whatever the case, it’ll be a really tight race all the way to the finish line.
: It sure will. But I’m sure we’ll reach a happy ending regardless.
: Have I mentioned lately that I hate both of you?
scene sanaayaneclothes32
: You don’t need to when it’s written all over your face like that. And, if it makes you feel better, I’m sure we’ll be keeping these outfits for use during more...private encounters.
: I might need help putting this one on again, though. It is...slightly more complicated than a sundress.
scene sanaayaneclothes33
: You look great, though...I’m sure Miss Watabe would be really happy to see her old clothes put to such good use.
: Sorry only a couple of them fit you right now, Sana. You’ll grow into them eventually. Maybe. The world has a weird way of both working and not working sometimes.
scene sanaayaneclothes34
: I guess so. I’ll probably grow a little more...But the chances of me ever being bigger than my mom are kind of slim, I think. She says I’m smaller than she was at this age.
: So unless I have a sudden growth spurt or something...you can probably count on me being pocket-size forever.
: What do you think, Akira? Are you excited to see Sana and I when we’re all grown up?
scene sanaayaneclothes35
scene sanaayaneclothes36
: Something tells me he’s going to look exactly the same fifteen years from now...and that you’ll wind up mature and beautiful.
: Are you saying I’m not mature and beautiful now, Sana?
scene sanaayaneclothes37
scene sanaayaneclothes36
: Of course not. Just that you’ll get even more beautiful as time goes by.
scene sanaayaneclothes38
: BUT I WILL ALWAYS BE THERE, WAITING FOR THE CHANCE TO STRIKE AND TAKE WHAT IS RIGHTFULLY MINE.
: IT MATTERS NOT, THE WAY YOU AGE. THE THINGS YOU’LL SEE OR WON’T. WHAT MATTERS MOST IS SUSTENANCE. WHAT MATTERS MOST IS HOPE.
: WILT LIKE A FLOWER. BURN LIKE THE SUN.
: AND WHEN IT ALL GOES AWAY, REMEMBER — IT DIDN’T HAVE TO BE LIKE THIS.
: IT COULD’VE BEEN ME.
scene threeflowers
scene sanaayaneclothes39
scene black
scene sanaayaneclothes40
Ayane went to sleep at some point.
I can’t exactly remember when.
scene black
scene sanaayaneclothes41
But this one’s still awake.
Still wearing her clothes.
Still resting her head on my shoulder.
Still waiting for me to strike.
But I can’t.
I can’t do anything.
I can’t find the words.
I don’t know which ones to even look for.
You’d think that I would know by now how to tell someone I’m afraid of them.
Or rather, that they do things that scare me.
Whether it be intentional or not is another question entirely.
But there is a presence in this room.
A fourth one.
That’s either been here for some time or crept in when I opened the door.
It wears the same dress she does.
Whispers things into my ear that come out garbled.
Gargled.
Spit me out.
: I love you.
: There...
: I said it this time.
scene sanaayaneclothes42
: You don’t have to feel bad about it anymore.
: And I won’t even make you say it back.
: But it’s the truth.
scene sanaayaneclothes41
: You and me...
: Will be together forever...
: No matter where...
scene black
: No matter when.
